name: Diona
notes: A Cryo shielder and healer who scales with Max HP. Both sources agree on 4pc Noblesse Oblige, HP% Goblet, HP% or ER Sands and HP% (or Healing Bonus or CRIT Rate) Circlet, and list the same three bows. They differ on the talent order: KQM puts the Skill first and Game8 the Burst; the card follows KQM and its Skill shield. KQM and Game8 differ on the first bow (Favonius Warbow against Elegy for the End); the card takes KQM's order, since the ER goal depends on it. Neither source gives stat goals. ER 180% is the top of KQM's range for a refinement 1 Favonius Warbow at C0 (160-180%); a Sacrificial Bow needs 145-165% and other bows 180-220%. The kit's Skill DMG line is an ATK multiplier; her shield and healing are Max HP.
